messages.subject: [FLR-list] Package release / distribution
messages.body_plain:
Hi Iago, FLRers,

I was wondering how things were progressing with distributing packages containing ADMB code (speciifcally FLSAM) through the main FLR repository? We have been "releasing" compiled versions of FLSAM through the HAWG googlecode repo (hawg.googlecode.com), but apparently the "downloads" functionality has been disabled. It would therefore be nice if there were a mechanism to release packages with ADMB in it via the main FLR repo... How is this progressing?

Mark
